Bright yellows, oranges, reds, magentas, and blues emerge, suggesting ethereal beings reaching toward a luminous pearl. This motif, inspired by a subconscious dream, references the legend of a woman giving her child to the moon, blending narrative and abstraction. Created through automatic painting and observation in liminal states between sleep and wakefulness, the work reveals imagery that is raw, intuitive, and emotionally resonant. Each brushstroke and color layer creates depth, texture, and a dialogue between conscious and unconscious vision. Ideal for collectors, interior designers, and contemporary art enthusiasts, this painting offers a striking focal point for modern interiors

title: KINGDOM OF LOVE
description: ¨KINGDOM OF LOVE¨ , 2022 Kingdom of Love is a visionary surreal painting inspired by a lucid dream in which ocean and sky dissolve into a unified, boundless realm. The figure transforms into multiple states—siren, ocean, and living presence—blurring the boundaries between self and environment. A distant castle emerges as a symbol of arrival, representing a return to belonging and emotional truth. This original artwork by Mexican artist Paloma Rocha explores themes of transformation, unity, and love as a state of being. Through symbolic imagery and fluid transitions, the piece invites the viewer into a contemplative space where identity expands and reconnects with a deeper sense of home. Acrylic, enamel, and oil on canvas 240 × 350 cm Unique piece, signed. Includes certificate of authenticity.

Set against a dynamic, colorful background, bright rainbow hues interspersed with gold evoke a figure wearing a floral hat, revealed through subconscious observation. The work captures the ephemeral beauty of dreams and intuitive imagery. Created through automatic painting, the textured layers and visible brushstrokes convey movement, light, and emotional presence. Each detail emerges organically, reflecting the artist’s inner vision and meditative process. Ideal for collectors and interior designers, this painting brings a vibrant focal point to contemporary interiors. title: LET GO
description: ¨LET GO” , 2017 Acrylic, enamel, and oil on canvas 120 × 90 cm “Let Go” is an abstract painting that embodies release and surrender through fluid, expressive movement. Gestural marks unfold across the surface with a sense of openness, allowing the composition to emerge without rigid control. The work captures the moment of letting go—of structure, expectation, and attachment. Created with acrylic, enamel, and oil on canvas, the layered surface reveals both intensity and softness. Areas of density contrast with more open spaces, reflecting the process of emotional and material release. The painting feels both dynamic and expansive, holding a sense of freedom within its structure. Created by Paloma Rocha, “Let Go” invites the viewer into a state of acceptance and flow. title: MATRIX
description: MATRIX, 2020 Acrylic and enamel on canvas 125 X 125 cm “ Matrix ” is a highly expressive, colorful abstract painting by Paloma Rocha. Dynamic crayon-like strokes and layered oil colors create intense energy, while textured surfaces reveal the first impulses of the Translucence series. Automatic painting and liminal-state observation allow subconscious forms to emerge, creating a vivid, emotional, and unfiltered visual narrative. Designed for collectors, interior designers, and contemporary art enthusiasts, this piece offers a bold, dynamic focal point for modern interiors. Its vibrant abstraction, subconscious-inspired imagery, and expressive textures bring energy, movement, and emotional resonance to any contemporary space.

title: MR LION
description: “MR LION” , 2022 Mr. Lion is a surreal symbolic portrait inspired by recurring dream figures that embody attraction, mystery, and emotional intensity. The character emerges as both presence and archetype, representing the duality of desire—romantic, shadowed, and transformative. This original painting by Mexican artist Paloma Rocha explores the intersection between dreams and lived experience, where symbolic figures manifest through memory and projection. The work invites the viewer into a space of introspection, where relationships, longing, and identity unfold through a poetic and enigmatic visual language. Mixed media on canvas 90 × 150 cm Unique piece, signed. Includes certificate of authenticity.

title: NATZIDE
description: ¨NATZIDE” , 2019 Natzide is a surreal self-portrait inspired by a dream encounter with a mystical feminine presence. The figure embodies wisdom, intuition, and a deep connection to the unseen, emerging within a luminous, celestial atmosphere. Created by Mexican contemporary artist Paloma Rocha, this original artwork represents an encounter with the inner self as archetype. The piece explores identity beyond the physical, inviting the viewer into a space of magic, introspection, and spiritual recognition. Mixed media on canvas 70 × 60 cm Natzide embodies feminine energy—intuition, sensitivity, and inner strength—rooted in a deep connection with the natural and the spiritual realms. Unique piece, signed. Includes certificate of authenticity.

title: ORIGEN
description: ORIGEN, 2020 Acrylic and enamel on canvas 130 X 130 cm “ Origen ” is an abstract painting by Paloma Rocha, reflecting the essence of beginnings and subconscious emergence. Vibrant colors and layered textures reveal intuitive forms and dynamic movement. Through automatic painting and observation in liminal states, subconscious imagery surfaces organically, expressing vitality, origin, and the unfolding of inner landscapes. The piece combines expressive brushwork, layered color, and textured surfaces to create depth, rhythm, and contemplative presence. Ideal for collectors and interior designers, “Origen” provides a vibrant and meditative focal point for contemporary interiors. Its abstract energy, subconscious inspiration, and layered textures make it an immersive and emotionally resonant addition for any modern space.

title: Profundidades
description: PROFUNDIDADES Mixed media on canvas 150 × 200 cm 2018 “ Profundidades ” is a large-scale abstract painting by Paloma Rocha that explores the sensation of looking beneath the surface, where color, matter, and movement reveal hidden layers. Through fluid abstraction, the composition evokes the changing nature of water, sediment, and terrain. Gold emerges throughout the darker areas as light interacting with matter, revealing new details as the viewer moves around the painting. title: SILVER SIREN
description: “SILVER SIREN” , 2022 Silver Siren is a surreal, large-scale symbolic painting by Mexican contemporary artist Paloma Rocha. The piece portrays a mystical siren suspended between dimensions, playing a flute that summons marine beings, spiritual guides, and dreamlike visions. Dolphins, celestial figures, and an astral version of herself unfold within a layered composition that evokes lucid dreaming and expanded states of consciousness. This original artwork explores the connection between the visible and the intangible, where intuition becomes a guiding force. Through fluid forms and symbolic imagery, the painting invites the viewer into a contemplative space where the unconscious, spirituality, and inner vision converge. Mixed media on canvas 95 × 95 cm Unique piece, signed. Includes certificate of authenticity.

title: STAY
description: ¨STAY” , 2017 Mixed media on canvas 75 × 60 cm “Stay” is an intimate abstract painting that reflects the tension between movement and stillness. Through restrained gestures and subtle layering, the composition suggests a moment held in suspension—an invitation to remain present within constant change. Executed in mixed media on canvas, the surface reveals delicate variations in tone and texture. Forms appear and dissolve, creating a quiet rhythm that unfolds gradually. Rather than directing attention outward, the piece draws the viewer inward, encouraging a slower, more contemplative engagement. Created by Paloma Rocha, “Stay” embodies the essence of presence and awareness. It offers a meditative visual experience that resonates with those seeking calm, introspection, and emotional depth. title: TODOS VAMOS A TAR
description: TODOS VAMOS A TAR , 2022 Todos Vamos a Tar is a large-scale surreal painting that operates as both narrative and manifestation. A knight and a child journey through a symbolic landscape toward the ocean, representing a return to origin, innocence, and emotional truth. The composition reflects a deep longing for belonging and the desire to reconnect with the self. Created by Mexican contemporary artist Paloma Rocha, this original artwork draws from psychomagic and dream symbolism. It becomes an energetic gesture—an act of calling in a new reality—where memory, imagination, and destiny converge in a poetic and transformative vision. Acrylic, enamel, and oil on canvas 240 × 350 cm Unique piece, signed. Includes certificate of authenticity.

title: TOGETHER NOW
description: ¨TOGETHER NOW” , 2017 Acrylic, enamel, and oil on canvas 120 × 90 cm “Together Now” is an abstract painting that reflects connection, presence, and shared existence. Through layered gestures and interwoven forms, the composition suggests multiple energies coexisting within a single moment. The work carries a quiet sense of unity without losing its complexity. Painted with acrylic, enamel, and oil on canvas, the surface reveals an interplay of textures and marks that build a dynamic yet balanced composition. Each element contributes to the whole, creating a visual dialogue between separation and togetherness. Created by Paloma Rocha, “Together Now” invites reflection on relationships, connection, and the present moment. It is a contemporary abstract work for collectors and interior designers seeking meaningful, emotionally resonant painting that brings depth, harmony, and subtle movement

title: Sedimento azul
description: “SEDIMENTO AZUL”, 2026 Materia Viva Series Mixed media on canvas 80 × 80 cm This textured abstract painting by Paloma Rocha explores the meeting of water and mineral surfaces through organic formations and layered materials. Soft sandy tones contrast with areas of turquoise blue, creating a composition reminiscent of coastal landscapes seen from above. Rough mineral textures interact with smoother passages of color, suggesting the gradual transformation of land through erosion, sedimentation, and water movement. Part of the Materia Viva series, the work reflects the artist's interest in natural processes and the visual language that emerges from the interaction between matter and its environment. Its subtle colors and tactile surface invite a closer observation of the forms and textures found in nature.
